meta.description: fr-022 ein.schlag (final) by wayfinder / farbrausch, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 5) taken from the release executable of fr-022 ein.schlag (final), carved by v2redux at its own format version (`corpus/embedded/fr022_final.v2m`). Music credited to wayfinder on Demozoo (fr-022: ein.schlag, 2002, production 26237). 120 BPM, 2:13, 7 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. Against the v2redux reference render it differs by -0.82 dB loudness and at most -1.39 @ 1000 Hz in any octave band (tools/unisynth-parity, A/B listening approved 2026-10-28). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
